class.name: GDCubismMotionLoader
class.brief_description: Legacy motion JSON to Animation resource loader.
class.description: Converter for [code].motion3.json[/code] resources. Reads at most 4 MiB and validates the motion schema, segment widths and declared counts before conversion. Uses [code]Meta.Fps[/code] for the Animation step and converts linear and cubic parameter curves. Restricted Beziers use the SDK normalized-time evaluation, ignoring authored control times. Unrestricted Beziers require both control times inside the inclusive segment endpoint interval; otherwise loading fails with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_PARSE_ERROR] and a diagnostic identifying the parameter and segment offset. Animation clamps out-of-interval handles, and SDK root selection can be discontinuous, which continuous sampled keys cannot approximate with a uniform small error bound. Such curves remain supported by native Cubism playback. Interior regression samples use an absolute value tolerance of 0.002; this is a tested tolerance, not a universal bound for arbitrary control values. Stepped handles still use infinity, inverse steps add a key offset, and non-parameter curves are skipped. Do not treat its output as lossless native Cubism playback. Use [CubismModelImporter] with [CubismModel2D] for the supported native-motion path; [member CubismMotionDescriptor.animation] is not required for that path.
